gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2121 experienced an overall gross reserve strengthening of GBP 3.7 million on prior years' provisions in 2019. This was primarily driven by deteriorations in Third Party Liability (GBP 11.5 million), Energy (GBP 4.3 million), and Pecuniary Loss (GBP 3.4 million). These adverse movements were largely offset by favorable reinsurance recoveries, which contributed an improvement of GBP 17.5 million. Specific prior year events contributing to reserve movements included significant creep in the 2018 Typhoon Jebi loss, strengthening of casualty reserves due to 2018 California wildfires and the MGM shooting, and large man-made losses from 2018 fires at Macy's and a Brazilian warehouse affecting the Marine cargo account, as well as increased political risk losses from the 2018 year of account.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and prior year development figures were taken from the technical provisions and the explicit 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' narrative note. Prior year development used is the gross (insurance liabilities) deterioration explicitly reported (GBP 3.7m). Some LOB mappings (e.g. 'Pecuniary loss'  'Professional Lines') are approximate because the standard Lloyd's LOB list does not contain an exact match. Individual named event impacts are discussed qualitatively in the report but not quantified at syndicate level; where RITC or special purpose syndicate effects exist they can distort triangles, but no material RITC distortion to the prior year movement note was indicated for 2019.
